tools.dependencies: Original project MIT display-value grammar reused as a bounded raw-syntax subset, Python standard library, POSIX limits and external qpdf JSON v2.

retained_attempt_notes: Original display grammar refused larger measured arrays/non-ASCII names. The raw-source subclass adds bounded arrays and reversible opaque names, with negative controls.
Initial partial-header proof refused bare object-ID plus space. Revised proof additionally requires exclusively validated stream-Length consumers or a source-table Page, and a following full header.
The first original accounting control used a wrong literal byte count in its corruption setup; its own mutation assertion failed. Corrected setup and all 46 controls pass.
Earlier two-source selection probes remain SOURCE_SELECTION_UNREVIEWED; these new complete-accounting proofs supersede only that audit status.
limitations: The six new complete source-body proofs do not establish recovery completeness for the other 273 sources.

All 75 leaves in the earlier 5d988d74a6e6 diagnostic page reference lacked MediaBox; qpdf exited 3 after applying letter/ANSI A. The new blank inventory exits 0 but does not supersede or solve that source-viewer geometry boundary.
Matrix/AP/QITE checks inherit prior source/output-pinned repair, rendering and role limits. No generic field exclusion or full visual-fidelity verdict is introduced.
The prior 13-site transformed reference remains reconstructed recovery evidence, not an independently obtained intact original.
No conversion, runtime, font or raster sweep is rerun; 1297-source conversion accounting remains 1252 PASS / 18 FAIL / 27 UNSUPPORTED.
Source documents, derived PDFs, stream/font bodies, titles, rasters and binaries remain external. Stream bodies are opaque copies/hashes/equality only.
No production, API, supported-format, output-PDF or release change. Full-fidelity parent work remains open.
provenance: New original MIT source-syntax/field/accounting code and controls. Reuses only this repository original MIT grammar and reviewed reports. No foreign converter, private HN/JBIG, vendor implementation or vendor font programs/outlines inspected or migrated.
